The Studio

The hands
behind your look.

Master Lead Artist

Mona

Co-Founder · Master Lead Artist
"I design brows for your face — not a template. Every client leaves with something entirely their own."

With over 18 years in the beauty industry, Mona has shaped the brows — and earned the trust — of thousands of clients across Southern California. Her reputation was built one appointment at a time: through precision, care, and a genuine commitment to enhancing what is naturally yours.

She is one of the most sought-after brow artists in the region — and holds a 5-star reputation on both Google and Yelp to prove it. Not because of a title. Because her clients keep coming back.

18+ Years · 5,000+ Clients Served · ★ 5.0 Google & Yelp
